speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis

Given your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, combined with a one-year history of an itchy rash on your upper body and face, along with numbness and tingling in your palms, this presentation is highly suggestive of Leishmaniasis, specifically the diffuse cutaneous form which can affect the face and extremities. I would like to confirm if you have noticed any open sores or ulcers developing on these rashes, and whether you have traveled to or lived in a tropical or subtropical region known for sandfly exposure?
